Juvederm Ultra 3 + Lidocaine (2x1ml)

Juvéderm® Ultra 3 is an injectable hyaluronic based dermal filler used to smooth medium and deep wrinkles like those between the nose and corner of the mouth and also great for lip volume. The added Lidocaine (a local anaesthetic) provides added comfort for the patient.

 

Key Features

  • Ultra 3 has a smooth gel consistency that allows for easy injection and natural looking results.
  • It can be used to treat moderate facial lines, wrinkles, and areas that require moderate volume restoration.
  • Includes lidocaine for a comfortable procedure.
  • Thicker formula than Juvéderm® Ultra 2.

 

Treatment Areas

  • Moderate nasolabial folds
  • Lip augmentations
  • Perioral lines
  • Oral commissures
  • Marionette lines

 

Results Duration

The duration of the effect can last up to 12 months. It depends on age, skin type, sports activity and applied technique.
